brand.name: MarketplacePH
brand.tagline: Post for FREE. Find Customers. Buy Local. Sell Nationwide. Grow Together.
brand.hook: Got a product or service? Post it. Looking for something? Find it. Connect directly.
footer.disclaimer: MarketplacePH connects buyers and sellers. Payments are made directly between you and the seller, so we do not hold your money. Always check the seller before you pay.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
home.why1_body: Post your products or services in under 2 minutes. No fees to list, no account bans out of nowhere.
home.why2_body: Every store shows its seller type and verification level, so you can tell a manufacturer from a reseller.
home.why3_body: Find suppliers near you or reach buyers across the Philippines. Chat directly and agree on shipping.
search.empty: No listings match your search. Try fewer filters or a different word.
filters.title: Filters
listing.hidden: This listing is hidden by the seller.
listing.removed: This listing was removed by a MarketplacePH moderator.
store.trust_note: Badges show how this seller identified themselves. Verification levels are reviewed by MarketplacePH. Always confirm details in chat before you pay.
store.setup_sub: One quick step before you post. You can add more later.
store.name: Store name
store.type: What kind of seller are you?
store.type_hint: Be honest — buyers see this on your listings.
store.contact_phone_hint: Optional. Shown publicly on your store page.
store.verify_note: You can get Verified badges later by submitting your ID and business documents.
sell.title: Post a listing
sell.subtitle: Free and takes about 2 minutes.
sell.need_photo: Please add at least one photo.
sell.name: What are you selling?
sell.tiers_hint: Lower the price per unit when buyers order more.
sell.qty_hint: Optional. Goes to "Out of stock" automatically at 0.
sell.description_ph: Size, materials, how to order, delivery options…
sell.invalid: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
sell.limit: You've reached today's posting limit. Please try again tomorrow.
sell.free_note: Posting is free. We never hold your payments.
upload.failed: One photo could not be uploaded. Please try another (JPG, PNG or WebP).
upload.hint: Up to {max} photos. We shrink them automatically to save your data.
my.title: My listings
my.no_store: You haven't set up a store yet.
fav.empty_items: Tap the heart on a listing to save it here.
fav.empty_sellers: Save a store to find it again quickly.
chat.empty: No conversations yet. Message a seller from any listing.
chat.too_fast: You're sending messages too fast. Please wait a moment.
report.notice: Reports are private and reviewed by MarketplacePH. Nobody is labeled publicly without review.
report.sent: Thanks. Your report was sent to our team.
safety.tip: Safety tip: confirm stock and details in chat, check the seller's badges, and keep payments and proof on record. Never pay anyone who pressures you.
auth.title: Log in or sign up
auth.subtitle: Use your mobile number — no password needed.
auth.bad_phone: Enter a valid Philippine mobile number, like 0917 123 4567.
auth.otp_failed: We couldn't send the code. Please try again.
auth.too_many: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.bad_code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
auth.have_account: Already have an account? Log in
auth.check_email: Check your email to confirm your account.
auth.google_unavailable: Google sign-in isn't set up yet.
auth.privacy: By continuing you agree to our terms. We only collect what we need (Data Privacy Act RA 10173).
account.privacy_body: You can download everything we hold about you, or delete your account and listings permanently.
account.delete_body: This permanently deletes your account, store, listings, messages and saved items. This cannot be undone.
account.delete_unavailable: Account deletion is not configured on this server yet. Contact support.
admin.title: Admin
admin.banned_hint: Listings whose title or description contain these words are blocked when posted.
notif.title: Notifications
notif.empty: Nothing new. We'll tell you about deals, reviews, verification and reports here.
notif.deal_proposed: A seller recorded a deal with you. Please confirm it if it is correct.
notif.deal_confirmed: The buyer confirmed your deal. You can now rate each other.
notif.verification_approved: Your {level} verification was approved. Your badge is now live.
notif.verification_needs_more: We need more information for your {level} verification.
notif.case_opened: A report was filed about you ({reason}). You have {days} days to respond before we decide.
notif.case_decided: We reviewed the report about you. Outcome: {outcome}. You can appeal until {appeal_by}.
notif.report_closed: A report you filed has been reviewed and closed. Thank you for helping keep MarketplacePH safe.
flag.title: Flagged by MarketplacePH after review
flag.body: This seller was flagged in {date} following a review by MarketplacePH. Take extra care and confirm details before you pay.
trust.title: Trust at a glance
trust.basis: Based on deals recorded by the seller and confirmed by the buyer on MarketplacePH. Amounts are shown as ranges for privacy.
badge.fast_responder.desc: Replies to most new chats within 24 hours.
badge.top_seller.desc: 20+ completed deals, a 4.5+ average rating and very few disputes.
badge.reliable_buyer.desc: 5+ completed deals with very few cancellations.
reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.empty: No reviews yet. Reviews appear after a deal is completed.
sheet.disclaimer: Information is provided by the seller and by MarketplacePH's records at the time of generation. Verification levels are reviewed by MarketplacePH. Trust figures come from deals confirmed on the platform. This is not a guarantee. Always confirm details before you pay.
sheet.private_body: Buyers choose who can see their information sheet. If you are chatting with this buyer you will see it from your chat.
check.title: Check muna bago bayad
check.subtitle: Look up a phone number, GCash name or store before you pay.
check.label: Phone number, GCash name or store name
check.exact: We match exact phone numbers, names and store names only, and show only flags confirmed by MarketplacePH after review.
check.flag_expires: This flag is reviewed regularly and expires {date}.
check.flag_note: A flag means MarketplacePH reviewed a report, gave the seller a chance to respond, and confirmed concerns. It is not a court finding.
check.none_body: That does not guarantee a seller is safe. Many scams are never reported. Check their profile, ask for proof, and use the tips below.
check.tip1: Confirm the seller's name on the GCash/bank screen matches the store or the name they gave you.
check.tip2: Ask for a photo or video of the actual item with today's date, and check the seller's badges and reviews.
check.tip3: For big orders, start small first, and keep your chat and proof of payment.
deal.title: My deals
deal.intro: A deal counts once the seller records it and the buyer confirms it. Confirmed deals unlock reviews and build trust metrics.
deal.empty_seller: Record a deal from a chat after your buyer agrees to order.
deal.record_hint: Only record real sales. The buyer must confirm the details before they count.
deal.sent: Sent. The buyer will be asked to confirm.
deal.err_chat: You can only record a deal after the buyer has sent a message in this chat.
deal.confirm_hint: Confirm only if this deal really happened and the details are right.
review.public_note: Reviews are public and cannot be edited. Be honest and fair.
files.failed: Could not upload that file. Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF under 5 MB.
verify.title: Get verified
verify.step1.title: Phone verified
verify.step1.body: Automatic when you sign in with your mobile number.
verify.step2.title: ID verified
verify.step2.body: Government ID plus a selfie holding it.
verify.step3.title: Business verified
verify.step3.body: DTI/SEC/CDA, BIR COR and Mayor's permit.
verify.privacy_note: Your documents are stored privately, seen only by MarketplacePH reviewers (every view is logged), and deleted soon after review. They are never shown to buyers.
verify.pending_body: Your {level} request is in the queue (submitted: {when}). We will notify you.
verify.all_done: Your store is fully verified. Thank you!
verify.form_id_hint: Use a clear photo of a valid government ID, and a selfie of you holding it.
verify.form_business_hint: Upload your business registration and permits.
doc.gov_id_hint: Passport, driver's license, UMID, PhilID, etc.
doc.selfie_hint: Your face and the ID must both be clearly visible.
doc.fda_hint: Optional. Needed for food, cosmetics and health products.
report.duplicate: You already have an open report about this.
report.evidence_hint: Screenshots of chats or proof of payment help us review faster. Only MarketplacePH staff can open them.
cases.title: Reports & appeals
cases.intro: Every report is reviewed by a person. Nobody is publicly flagged without notice, a chance to respond, a review and a right to appeal.
cases.reporter_privacy: For privacy, reporters' identities are never shared with the person they reported.
cases.due: Please respond by {date}. After that we may decide without your side.
cases.responded: We received your response. A reviewer will decide soon.
cases.appeal_hint: A different reviewer will look at your case again.
cases.evidence_hint: Receipts, delivery proof or chats that show what happened (up to 4 files).
cases.respond_once: You can respond once, so include everything important.
account.sheet_public: Make my buyer information sheet public
account.sheet_public_hint: Off by default. Sellers you chat with can always see it. Turn on to share your buyer record with anyone, e.g. to get supplier terms.
admin.open_case_hint: The reported user is told and gets the window above to respond.
admin.window_open: Response window is open until {date}. You can't decide until it closes or they respond.
admin.can_decide_expired: The response window has closed. You can decide.
admin.decision_note: Reason shown to the reported user
admin.decide_hint: Flags are public: only admins can publish them, with neutral wording, and they can be appealed.
admin.appeal_hint: A different admin than the one who decided should review where possible. Overturning revokes the flag or restriction.
admin.docs_notice: Documents open in a new tab via a link that expires in 60 seconds. Every open is logged. Don't download or share them.
admin.watchlist_hint: Public flags appear on the seller's pages and in 'Check muna bago bayad' only while live. They expire automatically and have a review date.
cart.title: Cart
cart.intro: Items are grouped by seller. Each seller gets their own order request.
cart.estimate_note: Estimate only. The seller confirms availability, final prices and shipping in a quote before you pay anything.
cart.how_note: You won't pay now. The seller replies with the final price and shipping, then you pay them directly.
cart.err_oos: This item is out of stock.
checkout.title: Request your order
checkout.intro: Tell {store} where to send it. They'll confirm stock, final prices and shipping before you pay.
checkout.privacy: Only you and this seller (and MarketplacePH staff if a dispute is opened) can see your address.
checkout.preferred_hint: Pick one you trust. {store} will confirm or suggest another.
checkout.no_pref: No preference — let the seller suggest
checkout.own_courier: Using your own courier, trucker or bus line?
checkout.note_ph: e.g. deliver on weekdays, call before arrival
checkout.no_charge: No payment is taken here. MarketplacePH never holds your money.
ship.pick_location: Choose your region and city above to see what usually works best.
ship.rule_note: A simple guide based on distance, size and urgency. Not a price quote.
ship.why.local_on_demand: fast and affordable inside the city
ship.why.pickup_local: no shipping cost if you can collect
ship.why.courier_small: good for small and medium parcels
ship.why.bus_cargo: bus cargo is affordable between provinces
ship.why.heavy_long: best for bulk or heavy orders
ship.why.heavy_sea: bulk across islands: truck with RORO/sea freight
ship.why.courier_sea: courier with sea or air freight between islands
listing.ships_hint: The seller confirms the shipping method and fee in the quote. You can suggest your own courier at checkout.
orders.title: My orders
orders.intro: Your orders as a buyer and as a seller. Tap one to see what happens next.
orders.empty_buyer: No orders yet. Add something to your cart to start.
order.legacy_note: This deal was recorded from a chat (sold outside the order flow). Once the buyer confirms, both sides can review.
order.title: Order
order.refund_note: If money was already sent, the seller and buyer settle the refund directly. MarketplacePH does not hold funds.
order.shipping_fee_hint: Your fee for the chosen method (0 if free).
order.quote_expired: This quote has expired. Ask the seller for a new one.
order.waiting_quote: Waiting for the seller to confirm stock, final prices and shipping. You'll be notified.
order.waiting_payment: Quote sent. Waiting for the buyer to pay.
order.waiting_confirm: Waiting for the seller to confirm they received your payment.
order.cod_waiting_pack: Cash on delivery. The seller will pack your order next.
order.paid_waiting_pack: Payment confirmed. The seller will pack your order and upload photos.
order.packed_waiting_ship: Packed with photo proof. The seller will ship it next.
order.delivered_confirm: The seller marked this delivered. Did you receive everything in good condition?
order.shipped_confirm: Received your order? Check it matches the packing photos, then confirm.
order.err_photos: Add 1 to 6 photos and tick every item.
order.err_link: Links must start with http:// or https://
order.quote_hint: Confirm what you have, set the final price per item and add shipping. The buyer pays only after this.
order.ship_via_hint: The buyer's own preferred courier is listed first.
order.pay_direct: Pay using the details below, then upload your screenshot and reference number. MarketplacePH does not receive or hold your money.
order.pay_check_name: Before sending: the account name should match the store or what the seller told you. When unsure, use "Check muna bago bayad".
order.cod_hint: You pay the rider or seller when it arrives.
order.no_pay_methods: The seller hasn't set up payment details yet. Ask them in chat.
order.review_hint: Check your GCash/Maya/bank app for the exact amount and reference before confirming.
order.pack_hint: Tick each item as you pack it, then add photos showing everything complete and in good condition before sealing. The time is recorded automatically.
order.pack_photos_hint: 1 to 6 photos. Show the items, quantities and condition.
order.booking_link_hint: Lalamove/Grab booking link or courier tracking page
order.terminal_to: To terminal (where the buyer picks up)
order.waybill_hint: Photo of the waybill or receipt from the courier or bus cargo
order.cancel_refund_note: If payment was already sent, settle the refund directly with the other side.
order.reorder_hint: Adds the same items to your cart at today's prices and stock.
reorder.moq: {title}: quantity raised to the current minimum of {n}.
reorder.out: {title} is out of stock, so it wasn't added.
reorder.gone: {title} is no longer listed, so it wasn't added.
reorder.nothing: None of the items could be added right now.
dispute.open: Report a problem / open a dispute
dispute.title: Dispute
dispute.process: A MarketplacePH reviewer will hear both sides before deciding. The other side gets 3 days to respond. We don't hold funds, so refunds are settled between you.
dispute.details_hint: At least 10 characters. Be specific: dates, amounts, what you expected.
dispute.evidence_hint: Photos, screenshots of chats or receipts (up to 6 files).
dispute.waiting_admin: Both sides have been heard. A reviewer will decide soon.
dispute.due: The other side can respond until {date}.
dispute.outcome_note: Outcomes are recorded and count toward each side's trust record.
shipset.title: Shipping & payment settings
shipset.intro: Choose how you ship and get paid. Buyers can add their own couriers too.
shipset.my_methods_hint: Add couriers, truckers, bus lines or riders you trust. Sellers see one only when you choose it on your order.
shipset.store_hint: Buyers see these on your store and listings. Your own saved methods can be ticked too.
shipset.listing_hint: Pick methods only for this listing (e.g. bulk goods go by truck). Leave empty to use the store's list.
shipset.pay_note: Buyers pay you directly. These details are shown only to a buyer who has a quote from you. MarketplacePH never holds the money.
shipset.no_pay: No payment accounts yet. Buyers can't pay until you add one.
shipset.no_store: You need a store to set up shipping and payments.
shipset.err_duplicate: You already saved a method with that name.
shipset.err_limit: You can save up to 25 custom methods.
shipset.name: Name
admin.dispute_hint: Buyer's favour cancels the order; seller's favour completes it; for partial / no fault choose how it ends. Outcomes feed trust metrics. Only admins can resolve.
notif.order_requested: New order request: {summary}. Send your quote.
notif.order_quoted: Your quote is ready for {summary}. Review it and pay the seller directly.
notif.payment_submitted: A payment proof was uploaded for {summary}. Please check and confirm.
notif.payment_cod: The buyer chose cash on delivery for {summary}. You can pack it now.
notif.payment_confirmed: The seller confirmed your payment for {summary}.
notif.payment_rejected: The seller couldn't confirm your payment for {summary}. Check the note and try again.
notif.order_packed: Your order {summary} was packed. See the packing photos.
notif.order_shipped: Your order {summary} is on its way via {method}.
notif.order_delivered: The seller marked {summary} as delivered. Please confirm once you have it.
notif.dispute_opened: A dispute was opened on your order ({reason}). Please respond within 3 days.
notif.dispute_resolved: A reviewer resolved the dispute on your order: {outcome}.
pro.note: This feature needs a paid FLAME PH membership. Subscribe to enable it.
biz.title: My business
biz.intro: Simple tools for selling and buying: customers, suppliers, reminders, reports, money and stock.
biz.no_store: You need a store to use the selling tools.
biz.card.customers: Everyone who ordered from you, with notes and tags.
biz.card.suppliers: Everyone you buy from, with one-tap reorder.
biz.card.reminders: Restock reminders for you, follow-ups for your customers.
biz.todo: Needs your attention: {seller} order(s) to handle as a seller, {buyer} as a buyer.
biz.advanced_body: Automatic customer follow-ups, SMS reminders, full reports, profit & loss and exports unlock with higher FLAME memberships.
sms.free_note: SMS reminders need FLAME Pro or higher. Subscribe to enable them.
plan.title: Plans
plan.intro: Basic selling stays free with FLAME Apprentice. Paid FLAME memberships add more listings, more affiliate links and advanced business tools.
plan.no_online_payment: Online payment for memberships isn't open yet. Send a request and our team will contact you and activate the tier you picked.
plan.request_note_ph: e.g. best time to call, number of stores
plan.fair_note: Basic selling and buying always stay free. Your data stays yours on every plan.
crm.intro: Built automatically from your orders. Only you can see your notes and tags.
crm.empty: No customers yet. They appear here after their first order.
crm.tags_hint: Separate with commas, e.g. vip, reseller
crm.notes_hint: Private: the customer never sees this.
crm.privacy: Customer details come from their orders with you. Keep them private and use them only to serve your customers (Data Privacy Act).
supplier.intro: Everyone you've bought from, built automatically from your orders.
supplier.empty: No suppliers yet. They appear here after your first order.
supplier.notes_ph: Private notes: prices to ask for, contact person, delivery days…
rem.intro: Never run out of stock. Reminders arrive in the app. (SMS needs FLAME Pro.)
rem.sms_body: Send restock reminders by text to customers who opted in.
rem.mine_hint: A nudge to reorder, delivered in the app. Free for everyone.
rem.title: Remind me to…
rem.supplier: Supplier (the reminder links to their store)
rem.follow_intro: Remind past customers to reorder, automatically. Per customer or per product. They can stop reminders from you at any time.
rem.follow_locked: Automatic customer follow-ups need FLAME Neo or higher.
rem.follow_hint: Sent in the app once the customer's last purchase is this old. Each customer gets at most one follow-up per week.
rem.message_hint: Optional. Keep it short and friendly.
rem.message_ph: Kumusta po! Time to restock? Ready stock pa rin kami.
rem.from_sellers_hint: Sellers you've ordered from may remind you to restock. Stop reminders from any of them here.
rem.sms_optin: Allow restock SMS from sellers I've ordered from
rem.sms_optin_hint: Off by default. Only sellers on FLAME Pro or higher can send SMS, and only if you turn this on. You can turn it off any time.
rep.intro: Numbers come from completed orders only.
rep.long_locked: Free accounts can view up to 31 days at a time. FLAME Starter and higher unlock any date range.
rep.none: No completed orders in this period.
rep.best_empty: Best sellers appear once completed orders include item details.
rep.pro_sections: Trends, best sellers and top customers need FLAME Micro or higher.
rep.pro_buyer: Spending by supplier and category, and trends, need FLAME Micro or higher.
rep.basis: Based on completed orders on MarketplacePH. Amounts include shipping. Not a substitute for your official records.
exp.title: Export
fin.disclaimer: A simple record of your own income and expenses. It is not accounting or tax software and doesn't replace an accountant.
fin.basis: Order sales and purchases come from completed orders. Everything else is what you enter below.
fin.pl_locked: Profit & loss by category needs FLAME Pro or higher. Free accounts keep the monthly summary above.
inv.intro: Keep your counts right so buyers see what's really available.
inv.low_banner: {n} item(s) are running low or out.
inv.rules: Stock goes down when you confirm a buyer's payment (or COD is chosen), and comes back if that order is cancelled. At 0 the listing automatically shows "Out of stock". Leave the count blank to not track an item.
sms.intro: Send restock reminders by text to customers who agreed to receive them.
sms.point1: Customers must opt in. Nobody gets SMS from you unless they turned it on themselves.
sms.point2: Every reminder also reaches them in the app, and they can stop reminders from you at any time.
sms.point3: Reminders can repeat at most once a week per customer.
sms.provider_note: An SMS provider isn't connected on this server yet. Reminders are queued below and will be sent as soon as one is connected. In-app reminders always work.
sms.sender_phone_hint: Used to identify your SMS setup.
sms.terms: I will only message customers who opted in, and I will stop when they ask. I understand SMS use is subject to the Data Privacy Act and the platform's rules.
admin.plans_hint: No payment provider is connected yet, so tiers are granted by hand after you agree terms with the member (or synced by FLAME PH). Every change is audit-logged.
admin.reminder_job_hint: Runs daily at 9:00 Manila time via Vercel Cron. You can also run it now.
notif.plan_activated: Your {plan} membership is active. Its features are unlocked.
plan.save: Save {n} a year when you pay yearly
plan.requested_for: Request received for {tier} ({billing}). We'll contact you.
plan.needs_note: This needs {tier} or higher. Subscribe to enable it.
plan.feat.customers: Customer list built from your orders, with notes and tags
plan.feat.suppliers: Supplier list with notes, favourites and one-tap reorder
plan.feat.inventory: Stock counts, low-stock alerts, automatic "out of stock"
plan.feat.finance_basic: Income and expense records with a monthly total
plan.feat.reports_basic: Sales and spending summaries (up to 31 days)
plan.feat.long_ranges: Reports and finance for any date range
plan.feat.reports_full: Full reports: trends, best sellers, top customers, spending by supplier and category
plan.feat.follow_ups: Automatic restock follow-ups to your customers
plan.feat.feed_export: Product feed (CSV / JSON) for other platforms
plan.feat.embed: Embeddable storefront widget and "Shop on MarketplacePH" button
plan.feat.sms: SMS setup for reminders (opt-in customers only)
plan.feat.finance_pl: Profit & loss by category over any period
plan.feat.featured: Featured placement on the home page
sell.plan_limit: You've reached the listing limit of your FLAME membership. Upgrade to post more.
aff.title: Affiliates
aff.intro: Earn a commission by promoting other sellers' items, or let others promote yours. Sellers approve every affiliate. Commissions are tracked here; payouts happen outside the platform.
aff.none_mine: No affiliate links yet. Open a listing that shows "Earn a commission" and ask to promote it.
aff.payout_note: Commissions are paid by the seller directly, outside MarketplacePH. We only record them.
aff.seller_hint: Turn on a commission per listing; nobody can promote it until you approve them.
aff.confirm_revoke: End this affiliate link? Orders already credited keep their commission.
aff.confirm_paid: Confirm that you paid this commission to the affiliate?
aff.panel_body: Promote this item with your own link. The seller approves each affiliate. You earn when a buyer from your link completes the order.
aff.login_to_promote: Sign in to promote this item
aff.pending_note: Waiting for the seller to approve you.
notif.affiliate_requested: Someone asked to promote "{listing}". Review the request.
notif.affiliate_approved: You're approved to promote "{listing}". Your link is ready.
notif.affiliate_rejected: The seller declined your request to promote "{listing}".
notif.commission_paid: The seller marked your ₱{amount} commission as paid.
store.links_invalid: Please check the links - they must start with https:// or http://.
share.title: Share & embed
share.intro: Bring customers to your MarketplacePH store from your Facebook Page, website or other platforms.
share.embed_hint: Paste the snippet where you want it to appear. It only shows your public items.
share.locked: The embed widget and product feed are growth tools.
share.feed_hint: A public list of your active items for other platforms, spreadsheets and ads.
flame.title: FLAME PH MSME Ecosystem
flame.intro: MarketplacePH is the Market Access engine of the FLAME PH MSME Ecosystem. Your FLAME membership tier unlocks listings, affiliate links and business tools here.
flame.training_body: Short courses on selling, pricing and bookkeeping.
flame.financing_body: Links to partner lenders and grants for MSMEs.
flame.mentoring_body: Talk to experienced business owners and advisers.
flame.events_body: Trade fairs, webinars and meet-ups near you.
flame.sync_note: Already a FLAME PH member? Use the same email on MarketplacePH and your tier is applied automatically once FLAME PH syncs it; until then, send a request on the Plans page.
